question: Does a moving hedge help a pair trade after costs?
main_test: Kalman minus fixed hedge, daily net returns in 2024-2025
pick_rule: Pick one entry level by fixed-hedge net Sharpe in 2023. In a tie use the higher level. Keep it for all methods.
size_rule: The small Kalman check uses a size set by the ratio of gate to full Kalman mean gross exposure in 2023. Do not fit this size on test data.
stats: Paired circular block bootstrap of daily test return differences, 14-day blocks, 2000 draws. Also show 7-day and 28-day blocks. Descriptive intervals; not a full correction for model search.
limits: One chosen pair, one venue, fixed cost cases, proxy marks for funding. No claim of a new method or live fills. Do not choose settings after seeing test results.
